name: taglib
input_api: taglib_file_new_type(local filename, TagLib_File_MPEG); taglib_tag_title/artist
scope: ID3v2 title and artist from a valid tagged MP3
family: TagLib ID3v2 parser
family_note: The C simple API delegates to the TagLib C++ core; C and C++ share the same ID3v2 engine.

name: mpg123
input_api: mpg123_open(local filename); mpg123_scan; mpg123_id3(v2)->title
scope: ID3v2 title/version after scanning valid MP3 audio
family: libmpg123 MPEG audio and ID3v2 parser
family_note: The same C library is called from C and C++; mpg123_scan reads the audio stream and mpg123_id3 returns parsed ID3v2 fields.

name: ffmpeg
input_api: avformat_open_input(local filename); avformat_find_stream_info; format metadata title and MP3 stream codec
scope: ID3v2 title and identified MP3 audio stream
family: FFmpeg libavformat MP3 demuxer and ID3v2 metadata reader
family_note: The same FFmpeg libavformat C demuxer serves C and C++ call sites. It identifies the MP3 audio stream and parses ID3v2 title metadata.

name: libid3tag
input_api: id3_file_open(local filename); id3_file_tag; id3_tag_findframe(TIT2); id3_field_getstrings
scope: ID3v2 title and normalized tag version/frame count
family: libid3tag ID3v2 metadata parser
family_note: The same C ID3v2 parser serves C and C++ call sites. Its API normalizes the input 2.3 tag to internal major version 4; it does not decode MPEG audio frames.

name: id3lib
input_api: ID3Tag_LinkWithFlags(local filename, ID3TT_ID3V2); ID3Tag_FindFrameWithID(TIT2); ID3Field_GetASCII
scope: ID3v2 title and frame count in a valid tagged MP3
family: id3lib ID3v2 parser
family_note: The C API wraps the same C++ id3lib engine used by the native C++ adapter. Both are one package path per ecosystem, not independent tag parsers.

name: libsndfile
input_api: sf_open(local tagged MP3 filename, SFM_READ, SF_INFO); sf_get_string(SF_STR_TITLE); sf_readf_float decoded audio frame
scope: ID3v2 title, MPEG Layer III sample rate/channels/frame count, and one decoded audio frame
family: libsndfile MPEG frontend over libmpg123 decoder and ID3v2 reader
family_note: The pinned libsndfile mpeg_decode.c uses mpg123_id3 and mpg123 audio decoding. This is a distinct package input API sharing the separately counted libmpg123 syntax engine. C and C++ call sites use the same C implementation.

name: libmediainfo
input_api: MediaInfoA_New; MediaInfoA_Open(local filename); MediaInfoA_Get general Title and audio Format/SamplingRate
scope: ID3v2 title, MPEG Audio format and 8 kHz sample rate from the tagged MP3
family: MediaInfoLib MPEG audio and ID3v2 parsers
family_note: Native MediaInfoLib parsers are used from both C and C++ APIs; these call sites share one parser engine across ecosystems. The source has File_Mpega.cpp and File_Id3v2.cpp; its libzen dependency is a base utility library.

name: sdl_mixer
input_api: Mix_Init(MIX_INIT_MP3); Mix_OpenAudio(dummy device); Mix_LoadMUS(local filename); Mix_GetMusicType/Mix_GetMusicTitleTag/Mix_GetMusicArtistTag/Mix_MusicDuration
scope: ID3v2 title and artist plus a 1-second MP3 music duration
family: SDL2_mixer ID3v2 tag reader and mpg123 MP3 decoder
family_note: The pinned music_mpg123.c calls mp3_read_tags from mp3utils.c and links libmpg123 for audio. C and C++ adapters use the same SDL2_mixer C API. SDL3_mixer is another major release of the same upstream package and is not separately counted.

name: sox
input_api: sox_init; sox_open_read(local filename, NULL, NULL, NULL); sox_read decoded sample; filetype and signal fields
scope: MP3 audio parsing and one decoded sample from a valid ID3v2-tagged input; ID3v2 text is not exposed
family: libsox MP3 handler over libmad decoder
family_note: The pinned src/mp3.c is the MP3 format handler and the installed libsox links libmad. C and C++ call sites use the same C library. The valid ID3v2-tagged control is accepted, but libsox does not return its title.

name: libmad
input_api: mad_stream_buffer(local bytes after ID3v2 tag); mad_stream_skip; mad_frame_decode; mad_synth_frame
scope: MPEG Layer III frame parsing and 576 PCM samples from an ID3v2-tagged local file; adapter skips tag header/body
family: libmad MPEG audio decoder
family_note: libmad is the same decoder family linked by the separately counted SoX package. It parses MPEG audio frames, not ID3v2 text. The adapter skips the valid control tag using its syncsafe length before calling libmad.

name: miniaudio
input_api: ma_decoder_init_file(local tagged MP3 filename); ma_decoder_read_pcm_frames; ma_decoder_get_length_in_pcm_frames
scope: MP3 audio parsing and decoded PCM from a valid ID3v2-tagged input; tag text is not exposed
family: miniaudio bundled dr_mp3 decoder
family_note: The pinned miniaudio.h embeds dr_mp3 code. C and C++ use the same miniaudio implementation. This is the same dr_mp3 lineage as the excluded SDL3_mixer major release; the library accepts the ID3v2-tagged control but does not expose its title.

name: csfml
input_api: sfSoundBuffer_createFromFile(local filename); sfSoundBuffer_getSampleCount/getSampleRate/getChannelCount/getSamples
scope: Fully decoded MP3 audio samples and stream fields from an ID3v2-tagged file; ID3v2 text is not exposed
family: CSFML wrapper over SFML SoundFileReaderMp3/minimp3
family_note: The CSFML C API delegates to the SFML C++ audio core, using its SoundFileReaderMp3 and bundled minimp3. C and C++ CSFML calls share the same library, and SFML is also counted separately in C++ as a distinct upstream package/API wrapper relation.

name: gstreamer
input_api: gst_filename_to_uri(local filename); gst_discoverer_discover_uri; gst_discoverer_info_get_tags/audio_streams
scope: ID3v2 title plus one parsed MPEG audio stream with sample rate and channels
family: GStreamer id3demux and mpegaudioparse plugins via GstDiscoverer
family_note: The C and C++ call sites use the same GStreamer C API. GstDiscoverer invokes the pinned id3demux and MPEG audio parser plugins; the monorepo and installed plugin binaries are pinned.

name: mpv
input_api: mpv_create/initialize; mpv_command(loadfile, local filename); MPV_EVENT_FILE_LOADED; mpv_get_property metadata/by-key/title, track-list/0/codec, duration
scope: ID3v2 title, MP3 audio track codec and duration from local tagged file
family: libmpv local media frontend over FFmpeg libavformat and libavcodec
family_note: libmpv links the same FFmpeg libraries used by the separately counted FFmpeg row; C and C++ use the same libmpv C API. The local loadfile command returns parsed metadata and MP3 track fields without playing sound.

name: lame
input_api: hip_decode_init; hip_decode1_headers(local tagged MP3 bytes); inspect mp3data_struct; hip_decode_exit
scope: MP3 frame header and 576 decoded PCM samples from ID3v2-tagged local bytes; tag text is not exposed
family: LAME HIP decoder interface over libmpg123
family_note: The pinned LAME HIP interface accepts the full tagged control and returns MP3 frame fields; the installed libmp3lame links the separately verified libmpg123 decoder. C and C++ use one C library.

name: aubio
input_api: new_aubio_source(local filename, native sample rate, 256); aubio_source_do; aubio_source_get_samplerate/get_channels
scope: MP3 audio stream fields and 256 decoded samples from tagged local file; tag text is not exposed
family: aubio source frontend over Apple AudioToolbox or libsndfile
family_note: Pinned source.c tries Apple AudioToolbox before libsndfile on this macOS build, and installed libaubio links both. The adapter does not reveal which backend succeeded; exact underlying decoder family remains unresolved. C and C++ share one aubio C implementation.

name: dr_libs
input_api: drmp3_init_file_with_metadata(local filename, callback); drmp3_read_pcm_frames_s16
scope: Tagged MP3 audio decode and raw ID3v2 tag recognition; does not decode ID3v2 text frames
family: dr_mp3 over minimp3
family_note: Standalone dr_libs release is a separate package path from miniaudio, but miniaudio embeds dr_mp3 and both derive MP3 decoding from minimp3. C and C++ adapters share this header.

name: vlc
input_api: libvlc_media_new_path(instance, local filename); libvlc_media_parse_with_options; libvlc_media_get_meta; libvlc_media_tracks_get
scope: ID3v2 title and recognized MP3 audio track from valid local tagged MP3
family: VLC media parser with bundled TagLib and MPEG audio plugins
family_note: VLC ships its own media pipeline and bundles TagLib metadata and MPEG audio plugins. Runtime module selection for this control was not separately traced. C and C++ call sites share libVLC.

name: sdl2_sound
input_api: Sound_NewSampleFromFile(local filename, desired, buffer size); Sound_Decode; Sound_GetDuration
scope: Decoded MP3 PCM, stream fields and duration from tagged local MP3; no ID3v2 text
family: SDL_sound over bundled dr_mp3/minimp3
family_note: SDL_sound is a separate upstream package from SDL_mixer. Its MP3 decoder embeds dr_mp3, also used by miniaudio and represented directly by dr_libs. C and C++ adapters share the same engine.

name: libmp3splt
input_api: mp3splt_set_filename_to_split(local filename); mp3splt_append_splitpoint(0,50); mp3splt_split with SPLT_OPT_PRETEND_TO_SPLIT and write callback
scope: MP3 frame-aware in-memory split of a 0.5-second segment from tagged local MP3; no ID3v2 text exposed
family: libmp3splt MP3 plugin over libmad and libid3tag
family_note: libmp3splt uses its own frame-aware split API with a bundled MP3 plugin linked to libmad and libid3tag. These underlying libraries also have direct rows. C and C++ call sites share the same plugin.
